archetype: THE PERFORMANCE PRO / SWISS & HIGH-CONTRAST (Local-First Precision Desktop App for Accountants)
theme: Light & Dark Toggle Support (Default: Crisp Slate Light for High Precision, with Deep Navy Dark Mode for Night Audits)
instructions_to_main_agent: Build a local-first Windows Desktop-style productivity application for accounting firms.

Workflow steps must be seamlessly supported: Firm Setup -> Client List/Creation -> Local Folder Workspace Selection -> Checklist Template Manager -> Scan Engine with Real-time Progress & Skipped File Warnings -> Review Center (Exception Handling) -> File Comparison View -> Reports Export (CSV / Excel / PDF).

Never simulate file deletion, auto-renaming, or external emailing. Always highlight the 'Privacy-First: 100% Local Execution - Files Never Leave This Computer' banner in the top navigation or status bar.
Supported extensions badge: PDF, JPG, JPEG, PNG, TIFF, DOCX, XLSX, CSV.

Review Center must be optimized purely for exception handling (not casual browsing), organizing issues into 6 core categories: Exact Duplicates, Possible Duplicates, Missing Docs, Wrong Period Docs, Wrong Document Types, Unreadable Files.
Action items for flagged exceptions: Mark 'Keep', 'Keep Both', 'Ignore', 'Review Later' with notes and confidence ratings.
Provide a split-pane / side-by-side File Comparison View for duplicate or wrong-period files with metadata diffing and document preview card.
Include a simulated desktop app title bar (Window controls: Minimize, Maximize, Close, Local Sync Status, Offline Verified Shield).

All interactive elements and data indicators MUST have strict 'data-testid' attributes in kebab-case format (e.g., data-testid='start-scan-button', data-testid='client-selector-dropdown', data-testid='privacy-status-indicator').
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) where appropriate (e.g., sticky desktop headers, modal overlays).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g. transition: all). Always specify explicit properties like transition: transform 0.2s ease, opacity 0.2s ease.
You MUST NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }). Preserve standard ergonomic left-to-right desktop reading flow.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or crisp sharp desktop buttons with stateful interactions and high accessibility.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 for UI icons. Use lucide-react icons exclusively.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, slide-ins, and progress pulses. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x generous spacing for desktop toolbars, split panels, and sidebar navigation. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle technical grid borders (1px border-border), clean status bars, confidence chips, and audit trail timelines elevate this app to top 1% quality.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include data-testid attribute for stable automated test verification.

colors.palette_archetype: Precision Slate & Accounting Emerald / Crimson Accent

layout_and_architecture.structure: Windows Desktop 3-Pane Layout with Titlebar Header, Left Navigation Sidebar, Center Workspace / Exception Review Grid, Right Evidence & Action Inspector, and Bottom Local Status Bar.

desktop_header.privacy_indicator: Green Shield Badge: '100% Local Sandbox — Zero Cloud Uploads'

review_center_features: Top Category Summary Cards with counters (Exact Duplicates, Possible Duplicates, Missing Docs, Wrong Period, Wrong Type, Unreadable)
Filter toolbar: By Category, Confidence (High/Med/Low), Review Status (Unreviewed/Keep/Keep Both/Ignore/Review Later), Search by Filename
Batch action bar: Select all -> Mark Ignore, Mark Keep Both, Export Selected
Split View: Left list of exceptions with severity badges; Right side detailed evidence card with side-by-side metadata match and suggested action rationale.

components.primary_buttons: Pill or sharp rounded-md with hover:shadow-md active:scale-[0.99] transition-all
components.badge_confidence: High (90-100%): Emerald badge | Medium (60-89%): Amber badge | Low (<60%): Slate badge
components.toast_notifications: Use Sonner for scan progress completion, batch status updates, and CSV/Excel/PDF export confirmation.

data_testid_conventions.pattern: kebab-case description indicating section and action

motion_patterns.page_transition: Opacity fade (0.15s) and subtle y-offset slide (8px)
motion_patterns.scan_pulse: Continuous glowing pulse animation on active scan radar indicator
motion_patterns.progress_bar: Smooth width transition with easeOut transition on scanning progress percentage
